titleZh: 初步调查显示，欧盟称TikTok违反DSA
titleOriginal: In preliminary findings, the EU says TikTok breached the DSA by failing to prevent its recommendation algorithm from trapping users in harmful "rabbit holes" (Alexander Martin/The Record)
summary: Alexander Martin / The Record：在初步调查中，欧盟表示TikTok违反了DSA，未能防止其推荐算法将用户困在有害的“兔子洞”中——欧盟委员会周五指责TikTok未能阻止其推荐算法将用户拉入……
